brief:
Israel has designated thirteen traders as sole distributors of bread in Gaza during the ongoing conflict, according to data cited by Shehab Wire. The arrangement grants these merchants monopoly control over a staple food source for the territory's population.

The move strips ordinary Gazans of choice in how they obtain basic sustenance, even as they face life-and-death decisions under wartime conditions. Citizens now depend entirely on these state-approved vendors for access to bread.

title: Israel selects 13 merchants to control Gaza's bread supply during war
